legend: Hamed has recently found a string t and suddenly became quite fond of it. He spent several days trying to find all occurrences of t in other strings he had. Finally he became tired and started thinking about the following problem. Given a string s how many ways are there to extract k ≥ 1 non-overlapping substrings from it such that each of them contains string t as a substring? More formally, you need to calculate the number of ways to choose two sequences a1, a2, ..., ak and b1, b2, ..., bk satisfying the following requirements:
![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/99ce7829f1cda3a108cb995b136005e31e6f5582.png)  t is a substring of string saisai + 1... sbi (string s is considered as 1-indexed).
As the number of ways can be rather large print it modulo 109 + 7.
input: Input consists of two lines containing strings s and t (1 ≤ |s|, |t| ≤ 105). Each string consists of lowercase Latin letters.
output: Print the answer in a single line.

legend.ai: Hamed 最近发现了一个字符串 t，并突然对它产生了浓厚的兴趣。他花了几天时间，试图在自己拥有的其他字符串中找出 t 的所有出现位置。最后他感到疲惫，开始思考下面的问题。给定一个字符串 s，有多少种方法可以从中提取 k ≥ 1 个互不重叠的子串，使得每个子串都包含字符串 t 作为子串？更形式化地说，你需要计算满足以下要求的两个序列 a1, a2, ..., ak 和 b1, b2, ..., bk 的选择方案数：
![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/99ce7829f1cda3a108cb995b136005e31e6f5582.png)  t 是字符串 s 的子串，其中 s 被视为从 1 开始编号。
由于方案数可能非常大，请输出其对 109 + 7 取模的结果。

input.ai: 输入包含两行，分别为字符串 s 和 t（1 ≤ |s|, |t| ≤ 105）。每个字符串均由小写拉丁字母组成。
